title: 2026 bioenergy and water scope QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Bioenergy factors apply to combustion of fuels from recently living sources at sites or assets under the reporting organisation's direct control.
The bioenergy section includes both direct Scope 1 and indirect Scope 3 emissions.
Water-supply factors cover water delivered through the mains supply network.
Water-treatment factors apply to water returned to the sewage system through mains drains.
Water supply and treatment are classed as Scope 3 emissions.
The 2026 water factors use a revised methodology based on 2021 UK water-company Carbon Accounting Workbooks.
The water calculation includes actual volumes of wastewater treated and drinking water supplied by each company.
There were no major methodological changes for bioenergy or water in 2026 beyond the documented data/method updates.
The methodology provides factor tables for water supply/treatment, biofuels, biomass and biogas.
Bioenergy factors include lifecycle net CO2, CH4, N2O and indirect/WTT components.
